nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b.description: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B on RunInfra Model APIs, the only model this pilot lists. The vendor's copyable examples send exactly nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b as the model; the model page also shows the upstream served name nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-BF16, which is not the id sent. The model page states a 262,144-token context window and 262,144 maximum generated output tokens. The chat-completions reference caps one request's output at the model's remaining context (its window minus your prompt) and clamps oversized values, so 262,144 output is a ceiling, not capacity beside a full prompt. This pilot declares text generate/stream only; tools, structured output, thinking and vision are not declared, which bounds this pilot and is not a claim the vendor lacks them. Availability is a runtime field and is unverified.

errorRules.message: RunInfra answered 401. The vendor's authentication page lists 401 Invalid API key and 401 API key has expired. Check {apiKeyEnvVar} and the workspace API key at {setupUrl}.

instructions: 1. Sign in to RunInfra and create a workspace API key under Settings > API keys at https://runinfra.ai/settings/api-keys. The vendor's authentication page says to send a workspace API key in an Authorization: Bearer header.

2. nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b is usage-priced per token in USD (the model page lists input, cached input and output rates per 1M tokens; rates may change). The vendor's plans page lists prepaid credits worth $1 each with a $5 minimum top-up, and a $1 signup credit, once per account, that it says never expires. Whether your account holds that credit is unverified, and this is not a free tier.

3. Set {apiKeyEnvVar}. The vendor's curl and SDK examples name RUNINFRA_GATEWAY_KEY, and its export block also sets RUNINFRA_API_KEY to the same value, which is read as a fallback. The key is sent as Authorization: Bearer to https://api.runinfra.ai/v1/chat/completions.

4. The vendor's chat-completions reference says a hosted model can be temporarily paused and then answers 503 with code hosted_model_paused. Availability of nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b to your account is unverified. The declared scope is text generate and stream with nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b.
setup.description: RunInfra text/stream pilot with a usage-priced nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b default. The vendor's plans page lists a one-time signup credit; no account entitlement, roster, live inference, availability or delivery is verified.

rosterVerified.method: Public vendor page GETs only: runinfra.ai/inference-api/nemotron-3-5-lightning-30b, docs/tools-sdks/openai-compatibility, docs/api-reference/chat-completions.md and authentication.md, docs/introduction/plans.md and docs/changelog.md. No GET /v1/models, credentials, account or inference ran; this legacy field does not assert roster verification.
